title: 第一卷 第9章 杀心第一卷 第10章 刘宏死
content_zh:
穿过青山城城门，太阳距离完全落山只剩下最后一小半了。
李乘风加急脚步往家里赶，路过一处巷子口时，瞥见了一道熟悉的身影。
往前走了两步一瞅，正是刘宏，顿时挑了挑眉毛。
往前看去，那刘宏看着心情不太好地踢了一脚路边的石头，神色沉郁地往回走。
李乘风顿时挑了挑眉，嘴角上扬。
看到这家伙心情不好，他的心情就好。
李乘风本来就因意外之喜而高兴的心情更加高兴了，没再管刘宏如何，心情愉悦地带着猎物往回赶。
加快脚步，在太阳完全落山之前回到了自家院子前。
“乘风，你回来了！”
篱笆院子里，一道倩影正满脸焦急地左右踱步等待着，等一抬头看到回来的李乘风，神色里顿时控制不住的喜意，急忙向前奔来。
“怎么现在才回来，天都要黑了。”
等李乘风打开院子之后，一把抓住他的胳膊，上下看着他，高兴不已地开口，眼里不自禁有泪花浮现。
“今天在山里有些意外收获，耽误了些时间，回来的晚了。”
李乘风看着刘玉娘的样子，脸上露出一抹笑容，神情喜悦地开口。
一边说一边将腰上系着的布袋和怀里一直抱着的装着兽血的葫芦拿出来递给她：“这葫芦里装着两个兔子和一个小黄鹿的血，你看看，袋子里还有两只肥兔，还有一只小黄鹿。”
李乘风一边说着，一边又将背后两张崭新的新猎弓取出来，挑着眉毛对着刘玉娘开口，擦了擦刘玉娘的眼泪，“别担心了玉娘，我这不是回来了吗，这么多收获，往后咱的日子可就能过得更好了。”
这个时代，男人是女人最大的依靠。
狩猎危险，李乘风今天进山这么长时间才回来，担忧是在所难免的。
李乘风见刘玉娘哭泣，只以为她为自己晚归担心，笑容满面地擦着她的眼泪轻声安慰。
“好，不担心了，我不担心了。”

刘玉娘声音哽咽，听到李乘风的话后也抬着手背擦了擦自己的眼泪，微微泛红的眼睛看着他开口，“乘风，我跟你说个事。”
“山里危险，你别去山里打猎了，我去给人洗衣服，你再看看城里谁家要短工，给人挑粪、劈柴都行，咱不去打猎了，好好在家过日子好吗？”
“咱们给人打工做活，虽然挣得少，但是胜在安全，咱俩一起努力也能吃饱饭过日子，别去山里打猎了，好吗？”
刘玉娘看着李乘风，声音之中挂着泪腔，说着说着，眼里又噙满了泪水。
“这……不去打猎了？”
content_en:
After passing through the gate of Qingshan City, the sun was only half-way away from completely setting.
Li Chengfeng hurried towards his home. When he passed by an alley, he caught a glimpse of a familiar figure.
He took two steps forward and took a look. It was Liu Hong, and he immediately raised his eyebrows.
Looking forward, Liu Hong kicked a stone on the roadside in a bad mood and walked back with a gloomy expression.
Li Chengfeng suddenly raised his eyebrows and raised the corners of his mouth.
Seeing this guy in a bad mood makes him feel good.
Li Chengfeng, who was already happy because of the unexpected surprise, became even happier. He didn't care about Liu Hong and drove back with his prey in a happy mood.
He quickened his pace and returned to his yard before the sun completely set.
"Chengfeng, you are back!"
In the fenced yard, a beautiful figure was pacing around and waiting with an anxious face. When she looked up and saw Li Chengfeng coming back, she suddenly couldn't control the joy in her expression and hurried forward.
"Why are you coming back now? It's almost dark."
After Li Chengfeng opened the yard, he grabbed his arm, looked at him up and down, and spoke happily, with tears in his eyes.
"I had some unexpected gains in the mountains today. I wasted some time and came back late."
Li Chengfeng looked at Liu Yuniang's appearance, a smile appeared on his face, and he spoke happily.
As he spoke, he took out the cloth bag tied around his waist and the gourd containing animal blood that he had been holding in his arms and handed it to her: "This gourd contains the blood of two rabbits and a small yellow deer. Look, there are two fat rabbits and a small yellow deer in the bag."
As Li Chengfeng spoke, he took out two brand new hunting bows from his back, raised his eyebrows and spoke to Liu Yuniang, wiping Liu Yuniang's tears, "Don't worry, Yuniang, I'm back now. With so many gains, our lives will be better in the future."
In this era, men are women’s biggest support.
Hunting is dangerous. Li Chengfeng went to the mountains today and took so long to come back. It is inevitable to worry.
When Li Chengfeng saw Liu Yuniang crying, he thought she was worried about her late return, so he wiped her tears with a smile and comforted her softly.
"Okay, don't worry anymore, I'm not worried anymore."
Liu Yuniang's voice was choked. After hearing Li Chengfeng's words, she raised the back of her hand to wipe her tears. She looked at him with slightly red eyes and said, "Chengfeng, let me tell you something."
"It's dangerous in the mountains. Don't go hunting in the mountains. I'll go wash people's clothes. Then you can see who in the city wants day laborers, whether it's picking manure or chopping firewood. We won't go hunting anymore. Let's live a good life at home, okay?"
"We work for others. Although we earn less, we are better off being safe. We can have enough to eat and live by working together. Don't go hunting in the mountains, okay?"
Liu Yuniang looked at Li Chengfeng, with tears in her voice, and her eyes filled with tears as she spoke.
"You...are not going hunting anymore?"
